title: Delay Llama
description: A singing voice made of formants (FOF synthesis), in the spirit of the classic Delay Lama: notes in, a chanting, humming, oohing and aahing voice out. Vowel, voice (the size of the singer) and mouth can be curves over the song; glide slides between notes that touch, vibrato wobbles, unison stacks detuned voices, echo adds the classic stereo echo. The pitch bend of the notes is sung by the voice itself.

parameters.name: vowel
parameters.doc: The vowel, 0 to 100: a (0), e (25), i (50), o (75), u (100), and everything between; a letter (a, e, i, o, u) or a curve auto(1:0, 4:100) that moves the mouth over the song.

parameters.name: voice
parameters.doc: The size of the singer, 0 to 100: low is a deep, big voice (formants down), high a small, bright one; a number or a curve.

parameters.name: mouth
parameters.doc: How open the mouth is, 0 to 100: closed is a hum (softer, more breath), open a full "aah"; a number or a curve (the llama opens its mouth with it).

parameters.name: glide
parameters.doc: How long the voice slides from one note to the next when they touch or overlap (legato); 0 jumps.

parameters.name: vibrato
parameters.doc: How deep the vibrato is; it comes in over the first 300 ms of a note, and a small wobble is always there.

parameters.name: vibrato_rate
parameters.doc: How fast the vibrato is (it wanders a little around this, like a real voice).

parameters.name: breath
parameters.doc: How much breath (air) is in the voice.

parameters.name: unison
parameters.doc: How many voices sing the same note (a choir of llamas), spread over detune and the stereo field.

parameters.name: detune
parameters.doc: How far the unison voices are apart, in cents.

parameters.name: spread
parameters.doc: How wide the unison voices are spread over left and right.

parameters.name: decay
parameters.doc: Time from full level to the sustain level.

parameters.name: sustain
parameters.doc: The level while a note is held.

parameters.name: release
parameters.doc: Time to fade out after a note ends.

parameters.name: echo
parameters.doc: The classic stereo echo of the Delay Lama (two taps, about 310 and 398 ms, with feedback): how much of the voice goes into it. 0 is dry.

parameters.name: leveler
parameters.doc: Keeps the voice from jumping out: what gets louder than about -10 dBFS (a low note, an open mouth, three llamas in unison) is turned down, slowly, and never turned up. 0% is off, 100% holds everything to that level. Use gain for the overall level.

parameters.name: character
parameters.doc: Show the llama in the window of the block (it sings along: neck with the pitch, mouth with the vowel and the mouth). Only the picture: the sound is the same.
